name: terabox
author: Satya
title: Satya TeraBox Downloader
description: Download TeraBox share links (terabox.com / terabox.app / 1024terabox.com / teraboxlink.com and other mirrors) directly with Gopeed. Resolves the files of a share (folders included), signs direct CDN download links and keeps them fresh so downloads run with many connections. Needs your TeraBox login cookie (ndus): TeraBox only issues download links to signed-in sessions.

settings.name: cookie
settings.title: TeraBox cookie (ndus)
settings.description: Required for downloading. Log in at https://www.terabox.app, open DevTools → Application → Cookies → copy the value of "ndus" (a full "Cookie:" header line also works). TeraBox only signs download links for logged-in sessions.

settings.name: password
settings.title: Default share password
settings.description: Used for password-protected shares when the link has no ?pwd= parameter.

settings.name: mirror
settings.title: API mirror
settings.description: "auto" uses the domain of the pasted link first and then falls back to the other first-party domains. Pick one explicitly if your network blocks some of them.

settings.name: apiBase
settings.title: External resolver API (optional)
settings.description: Base URL of a self-hosted Trauso/Terabox-DL compatible resolver (exposes /api/get-info and /api/get-download). Leave empty to talk to TeraBox directly with your cookie.

settings.name: maxFiles
settings.title: Max files per share
settings.description: Safety limit when a share contains large folders.

settings.name: folderDepth
settings.title: Folder depth
settings.description: How many levels of sub-folders to walk.

settings.name: ua
settings.title: User-Agent
settings.description: Override the browser User-Agent used for TeraBox requests (leave empty for the built-in Chrome UA).

settings.name: fingerprint
settings.title: Chrome TLS fingerprint
settings.description: Present a Chrome TLS fingerprint to TeraBox (helps against the anti-bot wall). Disable only if requests start failing.
